About.title: A Leading Omani Establishment
About.body: "All Roads" is a leading Omani establishment specializing in the consignment, marketing, and sales of GCC luxury vehicles. We believe your car is a valuable investment, providing a dedicated team to care for and market your vehicle, reflecting the highest standards of Omani hospitality.
About.pillarBody: 100% secure and guaranteed contractual & financial procedures

Services.title: Comprehensive Care for Your Investment
Services.salesBody: We handpick the best GCC spec vehicles, ensuring a transparent and secure purchasing experience.
Services.vipBody: We do not park your car — we invest in selling it. The monthly deposit (25 OMR only) is a symbolic contribution, not parking rent, for a full-time team to care for, polish, market, protect, and clear your car so it sells at the best possible price.
Services.clearanceBody: Our team handles all ROP & insurance paperwork, and we provide flexible bank financing options.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At All Roads Car Showroom, we are committed to protecting your privacy and the personal data you share with us through this website or our Meta ads.
Privacy.collectBody: We collect info provided voluntarily via contact forms (Name, Phone, Email) solely for communication and service provision.
Privacy.usageBody: Your data is never sold or rented. It is used internally by our sales team to address your inquiries.
Privacy.metaBody: This policy complies with Meta Platforms' requirements for advertising and lead generation.
Privacy.toolsBody: Inquiries, listing requests, and bookings are stored in our showroom dashboard. Chassis numbers, contracts, and owner documents are not published on the public site or given to the website chat.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Welcome to All Roads website. By using this site, you agree to the following terms:
Terms.natureBody: This site is an informational showroom. Bookings and deposits can be requested here and paid by bank transfer arranged with the showroom. We do not take card payments online and we do not store card details.
Terms.accuracyBody: We strive for accuracy, but hold no liability for typos. Physical contracts at the showroom are the final reference.
Terms.bookingBody: A booking request places a temporary hold (reserved). Staff confirm it after the transfer. Amount, refund, and duration rules are on the Booking & deposit terms page. Completing a sale still requires an in-person contract at the showroom.

Booking.name: Full name
Booking.depositTerms: The deposit is deducted from the sale price if you buy the car. It is refundable if the showroom cancels the hold. If you cancel after the hold starts, the showroom confirms any refund on site. No card details are stored.
Booking.termsRequired: Please accept the booking terms to continue.
Booking.success: Your booking number is {number}. Please transfer {deposit} and send the receipt. The car is reserved until the showroom confirms.
Booking.successNext: Keep this number. Staff will confirm once the transfer is received.
Booking.receiptLead: Optional: upload a bank-transfer receipt (PDF or image).
Booking.receiptOk: Receipt received. Staff will review it.
Booking.receiptError: Could not upload the receipt. Try a PDF or image under 15 MB.
Booking.unavailable: This car cannot be booked right now.

BookingTerms.title: Booking & deposit terms
BookingTerms.intro: These terms apply when you request a booking hold on a car listed at All Roads. They sit alongside the general website terms.
BookingTerms.depositBody: The deposit amount is determined according to the contract terms agreed between the showroom and the car buyer.
BookingTerms.refundBody: The contract's terms and conditions apply.
BookingTerms.durationBody: Any listed car can be booked by paying the agreed-upon deposit at contract signing, subject to all booking-duration terms stated in the contract.
BookingTerms.paymentBody: Deposits are requested by bank transfer arranged with the showroom. This website does not take card payments and does not store card numbers. You may upload a transfer receipt for staff to match. A card gateway may be added later; it is not active now.

inquiries.title: Inquiries
inquiries.lead: This screen is for customer requests that need a reply from the showroom team.
inquiries.botNote:
Messages arrive here from the website form, WhatsApp, and the website assistant when a customer needs a staff member.

The website chat and WhatsApp assistant (Wa-Agents) only answer automatically about cars published on the site. If the customer asks for a person, or about a contract, payment, pricing, or a complaint — or the assistant cannot answer — the request is sent here with a handoff reason.

The assistant's questions and replies are set in the Wa-Agents dashboard. This desk does not change those rules; it is where the team receives, follows up, and closes the request.

guide.title: How to use this dashboard
guide.lead: Follow these steps for daily showroom work. Editors see the floor tools. Admins also see Excel and staff.
guide.rolesLead: Both roles sign in here. The sidebar hides screens the signed-in person cannot use.
guide.rolesAdminBody: Full desk: inventory, listing requests, inquiries, bookings, Excel import/export, staff accounts, and deleting cars.
guide.rolesEditorBody: Day-to-day floor work: add and edit cars, inspections, contracts, inquiries, and bookings. No Excel, staff roster, or hard delete.

overview.title: Overview
overview.step1Body: If listing requests or new leads need a call, the banner sends you to that queue.
overview.step2Body: On-the-floor count, featured cars, bookings, buy-price stock value, and 14-day inquiry/booking charts.
overview.step3Body: Open recent owner requests from this page, then finish inspection and contract before publishing.
overview.step4Body: The right column lists names that still need a reply. Mark follow-up on the Inquiries screen.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.lead: Add, edit, publish, and hide cars.
inventory.step1Body: Use Add vehicle. Complete the five steps: identity, specs (including price mode), copy, owner, photos.
inventory.step2Body: The public site only requires at least one photo. Inspection, contract, VIN, and on-site checks stay optional desk records.
inventory.step3Body: Publish puts the car on the website. Hide, sold, or withdrawn take it off the floor and remove its QR.
inventory.step4Body: Open the stock code. Editors can edit and change status. Only admins can permanently delete.

pricing.title: Car pricing
pricing.lead: The public site shows only what you set here.
pricing.step1Body: Enter the OMR amount. Shoppers see it on cards and can book a deposit against it.
pricing.step2Body: Choose this when the amount should stay off the website. The listing shows “Request for pricing” and booking is closed.
pricing.step3Body: Enter the monthly OMR figure. The site shows that amount per month. Shoppers inquire rather than book a buy-price deposit.
pricing.step4Body: Re-open the vehicle, change the price mode on the specs step, and save. The public page updates immediately.

qr.title: QR codes
qr.lead: One QR code per listed car.
qr.step1Body: When a car is published (and not hidden), the desk creates a unique QR that opens its public page.
qr.step2Body: On the vehicle screen, download a PNG for print, or share the scan link.
qr.step3Body: Hide, sell, withdraw, expire, or delete a car and its QR is removed.
qr.step4Body: Open the vehicle screen. Listing creates the QR automatically. Use Refresh QR only if the image did not appear.

consignments.title: Listing requests
consignments.lead: Visitor cars stay off the floor until you approve them.
consignments.step1Body: Start review, schedule inspection, and keep notes on the owner.
consignments.step2Body: Log the inspection, then upload the signed consignment agreement.
consignments.step3Body: The car cannot publish until it is confirmed on the floor.
consignments.step4Body: Set pricing, then publish. The public site never shows owner contracts.

inquiries.title: Inquiries
inquiries.lead: Website, WhatsApp, and assistant handoffs land here.
inquiries.step1Body: Bot handoffs include why the customer needs a person.
inquiries.step2Body: Use the phone on the card. Mark the inquiry in progress when you start.
inquiries.step3Body: Stock codes appear when the customer asked about a listed car.
inquiries.step4Body: Sold, booked, or closed — do not leave names sitting in New.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.lead: Deposits hold a listed buy-price car.
bookings.step1Body: Only cars with a buy price and published status accept a booking.
bookings.step2Body: Mark the receipt paid when the deposit arrives.
bookings.step3Body: Approve turns the hold into booked. Cancel returns the car to the floor.
bookings.step4Body: Holds expire on the booked dates. Follow up before the floor goes quiet.

excel.title: Excel import / export
excel.step1Body: Keep the column headers. One car per row.
excel.step2Body: Price is the buy amount. Optional PriceMode: buy, request, or finance. FinanceMonthly is the monthly OMR figure.
excel.step3Body: Matching stock numbers update. New numbers add cars. Choose what to do with rows missing from the file.
excel.step4Body: Showroom sheet for the daily floor list. Full catalog for backup.

staff.title: Staff
staff.step1Body: Email or Omani phone, role admin or editor, optional password (or generate one).
staff.step2Body: The password is shown once. Send it on a private channel.
staff.step3Body: Keep at least one admin. You cannot demote yourself if you are the last admin.
staff.step4Body: Use the roster to reset a colleague, or change your own password at the bottom of the page.

import.title: Excel import / export
import.lead: Download the template, fill it in, then upload it to update inventory. You can also export the current data.
import.how1Body: Start with the Excel template. The columns are ready: stock number, car type, color, seats, year, mileage, price, and notes.
import.how2Body: Add one car per row. Do not rename the column headers. Leave a row blank if you do not want to import it.
import.how3Body: After saving, choose Import file. If the stock number already exists, that car is updated. If it is new, a car is added.
import.how4Body: Export showroom sheet gives the daily floor list. Export full catalog gives every field for follow-up or backup.
import.exportHint: Full catalog has every field. The showroom sheet matches the floor list you already use.
import.importHint: Upload the filled template. Empty rows are skipped. Updates match on stock number.
